native_mechanisms: Each mark is folded into an impure (non-pure-prime) accumulator and the accumulator's new state becomes the seed for the next mark, so the whole buffer passes through as one unbroken sequential chain, no byte judged alone or twice.
The chain's final state is carried through seven successive bending stages, each discarding half of what it received (a shift) and keeping only the volatile part, before passing it on.
Avalanche falsification test: flip one bit anywhere in the input, rerun the whole pour from the start, and discard the entire method if the new digest resembles the old.
core_technique: Verbatim xxHash64: four parallel 64-bit lanes of rotate-multiply accumulation over 32-byte stripes, lane merge, length injection and 8/4/1-byte tail folding, closed by a Murmur3/SplitMix-style xor-shift-multiply finaliser extended to seven stages (length-gated to three for short inputs).
